Harness-Work-Order: WO-PLG-002
Harness-Restitution: ef4484e7ce8c78965d0e08d5d8249d139846070afadc620183064003ee6b5be3

Add the Verity Plane setup skill and its exact PowerShell/Bash procedure for using provided Python. The agent checks prerequisites and the trusted wheel, prepares an external private environment offline, and reuses it only after fresh released-identity and observed-archive checks. Missing Python gets installation guidance; the plugin contains no interpreter or new bootstrap executable.

The acceptance runner executes the command blocks directly from the skill reference. Its code stays under tests and is not shipped with the plugin. Repository initialization, host activation and upgrades remain separate work.

## Validation

- VER-PLG-002 ENV01–ENV12 passed on Windows/Python 3.11.9/evaluator 0.16.0, Windows/Python 3.14.6/evaluator 0.17.0, and Ubuntu under WSL2/Python 3.12.3/evaluator 0.16.0. Linux ran in an isolated network namespace with no external interfaces or routes.
- Four focused tests, skill validation, distribution validation, candidate CLI help, released managed integrity, graph validation and the scoped handoff check passed.
- The full Windows repository suite ran 1,126 tests with one error and 23 skips. Its Git-object cleanup error reproduces on unchanged main at `3143613e`; no exception is claimed and the local full suite is not reported as passing.
- Linux Python 3.11 and macOS remain unqualified. Missing-module/old-version prerequisite cases use explicit failure injection. No live native-plugin activation is claimed.

The [evidence report](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/work/plugin-environment-setup/docs/engineering/plugin-integration/evidence/WO-PLG-002/README.md) includes fixed expectations, commands, observations, timings, original failed attempts and platform limits. The [test guide](https://github.com/mmzen/se_harness/blob/work/plugin-environment-setup/tests/plugin_integration/environment_setup/README.md) explains the explicit acceptance commands; top-level unittest discovery does not include these focused tests.

## Decision boundary

The operator explicitly authorized WO-PLG-002 on 2026-09-09. The released evaluator recorded approval and start. Implementation inputs are committed at `ad9cb2cba0f9168a3f2b63f62d2d63a19a548578`; the following commit retains evidence.

WO-PLG-002 remains **in_progress**, pending the engineering owner's completion decision after reviewing the implementation and limits. No VREC preparation, assurance, release or merge decision has been made. This PR is draft.
